name: Heracross
flavour_text: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

name: Burmy
flavour_text: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

name: Mothim
flavour_text: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.

name: Combee
flavour_text: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

name: Vespiquen
flavour_text: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

name: Cherubi
flavour_text: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

name: Cherrim
flavour_text: As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still, placidly waiting for sunlight to appear.

name: Cherrim
flavour_text: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It’s full of energy while it’s like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

name: Carnivine
flavour_text: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Houndour
flavour_text: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

name: Houndoom
flavour_text: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

name: Heatran
flavour_text: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Marill
flavour_text: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

name: Azumarill
flavour_text: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

name: Barboach
flavour_text: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.

name: Whiscash
flavour_text: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

name: Snorunt
flavour_text: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

name: Froslass
flavour_text: When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become decorations.

name: Snover
flavour_text: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

name: Abomasnow
flavour_text: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

name: Origin Forme Palkia
flavour_text: It soars across the sky in a form that greatly resembles the creator of all things. Perhaps this imitation of appearance is Palkia’s strategy for gaining Arceus’s powers.

name: Phione
flavour_text: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Electrike
flavour_text: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Manectric
flavour_text: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

name: Clefairy
flavour_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavour_text: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Gastly
flavour_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavour_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Gengar
flavour_text: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

name: Unown
flavour_text: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Rotom
flavour_text: Its electricity-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

name: Sudowoodo
flavour_text: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

name: Phanpy
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won’t be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

name: Donphan
flavour_text: Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being hit by a car won’t faze this Pokémon. However, it is extremely susceptible to rain.

name: Larvitar
flavour_text: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

name: Pupitar
flavour_text: Its shell is as hard as bedrock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

name: Tyranitar
flavour_text: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn’t care about others.

name: Nosepass
flavour_text: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it’s in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.

name: Meditite
flavour_text: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

name: Medicham
flavour_text: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe’s next move.

name: Gible
flavour_text: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gabite
flavour_text: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

name: Zubat
flavour_text: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Golbat
flavour_text: It loves to drink other creatures’ blood. It’s said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it’s gathered.

name: Crobat
flavour_text: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target’s neck.

name: Croagunk
flavour_text: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavour_text: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

name: Magnemite
flavour_text: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavour_text: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Magnezone
flavour_text: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Mawile
flavour_text: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Bronzor
flavour_text: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.

name: Bronzong
flavour_text: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

name: Origin Forme Dialga
flavour_text: Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokémon. Dialga now wields such colossal strength that one must conclude this is its true form.

name: Giratina
flavour_text: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Snorlax
flavour_text: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Hoothoot
flavour_text: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Noctowl
flavour_text: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

name: Starly
flavour_text: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Staravia
flavour_text: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

name: Staraptor
flavour_text: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Shaymin
flavour_text: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

name: Arceus
flavour_text: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

name: Houndoom
flavour_text: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

name: Marill
flavour_text: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

name: Unown
flavour_text: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Sudowoodo
flavour_text: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

name: Magnemite
flavour_text: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.
